panel: Frozen Atlas 1896 x 24 months x 6 categories; retrospectively fixed complete cohort
peer_features: 2023 only; five mean category/all ratios, log population, log mean all, log all slope, log all std. Current dictionary retrospectively mapped.

anomaly.share_unit: percentage points of category/all supplied indicators, not household budget
anomaly.peer: median of fixed 2023 peers; own excluded
anomaly.robust_score: peer gap / max(1.4826 peer MAD,0.25 percentage points)
anomaly.flag: abs(peer gap)>=1pp and abs(score)>=3 and peer/common gap same sign
anomaly.persistent: 3 consecutive flagged months of same sign in July-December 2024
anomaly.ranking: absolute median peer gap October-December; all qualified retained, no p-values
anomaly.nominal_confirmation: relative nominal YoY growth minus fixed-peer median; abs gap >=5pp for >=3 July-December months
anomaly.story_selection: top 3 positive and top 3 negative persistent marketplace gaps; cities preferred when supported, nationwide full ranking and search retained; Orsk/Kurgan/Ishim context separately

forecast.factor: fixed 1896 panel category median observed at origin; recomputed MAE not same as original R9 mask
forecast.correction_training: pooled past one-step log(actual/profile_ses) across supported municipalities; origin u >=2024-01, u+1<=forecast origin
forecast.fallback: zero correction (exact Profile SES), explicit COLD_START; unsupported peers excluded from every primary metric model equally and retained in coverage
forecast.calibration: mean historical one-step log residual, clipped [-0.1,0.1]
own_features: marketplace nominal log YoY common gap
all nominal log YoY common gap
food nominal log YoY common gap
forecast.peer_features: five same quantities minus own fixed-peer medians, appended to five own features
forecast.standardization: training rows only mean/std; zero training std -> scale 1
forecast.ridge: mean squared log residual + 0.1 * squared coefficients; intercept unpenalized; fixed before experiment
forecast.horizon_rule: same past one-step learned correction applied multiplicatively at h1/3/6; no claim of h-specific training
forecast.mask: all forecasts on identical supported-peer municipalities and target keys; no outcome-driven exclusions
forecast.primary_comparison: peer_ridge vs profile_ses on All categories h1, then peer_ridge vs own_ridge incremental value
forecast.uncertainty: 10000 paired bootstrap resamples of target-month blocks (6); separate region-block sensitivity; no independent-row CI

audit: future mutation of entire consumption panel preserves 2023 matches
future mutation at every forecast origin preserves feature inputs and model predictions
scalar SES vs vector baseline on sampled real keys
independent scalar ridge fit and train label cutoffs
synthetic identical common growth is not unusual; injected persistent exception flags
limits: All 2024 outcomes already viewed; no unseen holdout or scientific PASS
Historical release vintages and availability not verified; prefix invariance conditional on frozen revised files
Complete-panel membership and dictionary are retrospectively fixed
One prior year and only six target-month blocks; selected histories are descriptive, not causal
Category/all ratios have common denominator; nominal confirmation is separate but not independent household evidence
Correction only learned from past one-step outcomes; h3/h6 persistence assumption explicit
No prices, transactions, debt, shopper composition or causal crisis labels
